units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 40:23">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XL, 23</cite> (Y. I a. O. <cite ref="O00201"><he>סַדַּר</he></cite>, some ed. <cite ref="O00199"><he>סָדַר</he></cite>). Targ. Y. ib. XII, 39; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>סְדִיר</he>; f. <cite ref="O00186"><he>סְדִירָא</he></cite>.
Targ. Ps. VII, 13 ranged
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 22:9">Targ. Gen. XXII, 9</cite> (Y. ed. Vien. <cite ref="O00199"><he>סָדר</he></cite>). Ib. XIV, 8 (O. ed. Amst. <he>סְדָרוּ</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 13:18">Targ. Job XIII, 18</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="O00200"><he>סְדַר</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 5:4">Targ. Ps. V, 4</cite> (v. <cite ref="O00199">preced.</cite>).—Part. pass. <he>מְסַדַּר</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 24:6">Targ. Y. Lev. XXIV, 6</cite> (not <he>מְסַדֵּר</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 39:18">Targ. Y. Ex. XXXIX, 18</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 39:37">37</cite>.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 13a:14">Ber. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>התם נביא הוא דקא מְסַדֵּר לשבחיה וכ׳</he> there (<cite ref="Nehemiah 9:7">Neh. IX, 7</cite> where Abram is used instead of Abraham) the prophet praises the Lord by referring to the past.

<cite ref="Yoma 38b:7">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>דהוה מְסַדֵּר אגדתא קמיה</he> who reviewed before him the homiletic sayings according to a certain system; a. fr.—Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ <he>נקרוץ נְסַדֵּר לאילין וכ׳</he> let us get up early and set in order those thorn-bushes (meaning, let us kill those men).—

<cite ref="Shevuot 30b:8">Shebu. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>דמחזי כמאן דמְסַדַּר דיניה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דסַדַּר ליה לדיניה</he>) he has the appearance of one whose case has been prearranged (with the judge; ed.: of one who has prearranged his case).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 113b:9">B. Mets. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>השתא … סַדּוּרֵי מְסַדְּרִינָן ליה</he> since we order his pledge (which consists of necessaries) to be sold for his debt, how can we allow him an exemption (so as to leave him a certain amount from the money realized by the sale)?
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 36:19">Targ. Job XXXVI, 19</cite>.
